headline: PHI @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.10 at LAD 2.65, with a projected total of 5.76. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved -0.45 runs while LAD moved -1.18, changing the projected margin by +0.72 runs. The projected total fell -1.63, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +19.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Brandon Marsh, Teoscar Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Justin Crawford because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
